citation: A. D. G. Johnson, S. R. Otto, P. C. W. Richardson and S. P. Isaac, The R&A, "An investigation into ball-turf impact characteristics" (September 2008), tables 2 and 3 and figures 11, 13, 15, 23, 25, 27, 35, 37 and 39.

conditions.lie: driver teed 35 mm, other clubs on fairway 5 mm

targets.note: Site means read from the report's figures. The inbound values are the club's achieved mean for every site. Outbound spin is the inbound spin less the plotted change in spin. The report gives no spread, so each check is the club's largest gap between the two balls' means at one site. The earlier implementation has no turf stiffness. Ball: the ionomer-covered calibration ball or the urethane-covered Pro V1.
